slides.headline: QUALCOMM'S ROBOT WENT DOWN MID-SHOW
slides.body: A Qualcomm-powered humanoid robot collapsed in the middle of the company's keynote presentation. It went down on stage in front of the entire audience and the show stopped cold

slides.headline: STAGEHANDS THREW A CLOTH OVER IT
slides.body: The crew was already in position, which means they expected the robot might fail. They cloaked the fallen robot and carried it off stage like a body while the entire audience watched

slides.headline: AI RUNS THOUSANDS OF BUSINESSES TODAY
